title: Quaternion Maximum-Volume Submatrix Selection with Applications to Multichannel Imaging and Visual Data
summary: Low-rank approximation based on selected rows and columns is a useful alternative to singular value decompositions when the goal is an interpretable and compact matrix representation. A standard way to choose these rows and columns is the maximum-volume principle: it selects submatrices with large volume, which usually leads to stable interpolation coefficients and accurate CUR-type approximations.
